title: Mentor Krish — SAT & Admissions Platform
subtitle: High-Converting EdTech Portal, DSAT Testing & Knowledge Base
headline: Production educational consultancy platform and Digital SAT prep portal built for Mentor Krish by Abhishek and Vaibhav.
summary: Full-scale commercial EdTech platform engineered by Abhishek and Vaibhav for Mentor Krish, continuously supported under active maintenance. The platform features targeted test prep curricula (SAT, PSAT, ACT, IELTS, TOEFL), an interactive academic roadmap, verified student achievement showcases, an academic knowledge base, and direct consultation booking.
whatWasBuilt: Full-stack responsive web application featuring academic program catalogs, an interactive 4-stage student roadmap, a 'Moments of Excellence' modal lightbox gallery for verified student scores (AP 5/5 achievements), a searchable blog and test prep knowledge base, and an integrated diagnostic trial booking engine.
technicalChallenge: Delivering a comprehensive, high-converting EdTech platform with sub-second page performance, accessible responsive typography for students, and an intuitive content layout for high-volume course and blog updates.
architecturalSolution: Engineered an optimized React and Next.js platform with Tailwind CSS, utilizing server-rendered SEO landing pages, client-side dynamic search and category filters for academic articles, interactive modal showcases, and streamlined lead booking routing.
highlights: High-converting commercial platform engineered by Abhishek & Vaibhav (continuously maintained)
Full academic prep curriculum portal for Digital SAT, PSAT, ACT, and IELTS
Interactive 4-step diagnostic academic roadmap with visual milestone tracking
'Moments of Excellence' interactive lightbox gallery celebrating student score breakthroughs
High-performance searchable knowledge base with instant category filtering
Frictionless diagnostic trial booking and inquiry workflows
